Privacy

Privacy, kept simple.

How this website works.

A simple website

This website does not include advertising trackers, third-party analytics, a contact form, accounts, or a newsletter signup. Its pages, images, and styles are served as ordinary files. It does not set cookies or use browser storage.

When you visit

The server hosting this website may record ordinary request logs, such as an IP address, requested page, browser information, and time of access. The handling and retention of those logs depend on the hosting configuration.

Search and external links

The journal’s search and filters run in your browser. Search terms may appear in the page URL. Email links open your email application; phone links open your device’s calling application. Following links to Kean Miller, YouTube, or other websites takes you to services with their own privacy policies. Embedded third-party videos have been replaced with links.

Contact

Questions about this personal website may be directed to matthew.miller@keanmiller.com. An inquiry does not create an attorney-client relationship. Please do not send confidential information unless you have already signed paperwork to engage Kean Miller to represent you.
